method: Joint LP over per-class unary friction u_s[c], u_k[c] >= 0 with u_k[c] <= u_s[c] for every class (objects including mixed_unclear, pads, tables, ground). Under PhysX average combine a pair realises (u_a + u_b)/2, which must lie in the pair band. Stage 1 maximises the common minimum margin t over static and kinetic rows; stage 2 maximises the static margin with kinetic rows held at margin >= t; stage 3 maximises the kinetic margin with static held at its stage-2 optimum. Margins are in effective-friction units (the realised pair coefficient), not pair sums. Rows: every pair that co-occurs in a scored episode. Ground "multiply" is the shipped ground (unary 1.0, multiply: realised = u_obj); "average" sets the ground material to average with its own unary. pad_elastomer is also run in max mode (realised = max(u_obj, u_pad)). Pure-python two-phase simplex with constraint generation; no scipy.
combine_rule: PhysX effective friction combine mode = max(mode0, mode1) with average < min < multiply < max (PxMaterial.h); PhysX also clamps static >= dynamic. The Ground prim in every layout sets friction 1.0 and combine mode multiply, so all object-ground pairs are multiply as shipped.

per_asset_override_bottle_00022.note: The interval is for the stage-3 default solution (pad_hard, table_laminate, ground average); u_k <= u_s must also hold for the override.
